title: SNL Weekend Update: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on A.I.'S Threat to Humanity [video]
summary: This is a Saturday Night Live 'Weekend Update' comedy sketch featuring a cast member impersonating Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei discussing AI's threat to humanity. The Hacker News submission links to the YouTube video and its discussion thread, which drew 189 points and 101 comments. It is satirical commentary on AI safety concerns rather than technical AI/ML content.
